brief:
Israeli forces shot and wounded two Palestinians, including a 15-year-old child, during a raid on the al-Amari refugee camp in al-Bireh early Saturday morning, Wafa reported. The operation took place in the densely populated camp, which has been a flashpoint for Israeli-Palestinian tensions.

Following the shooting, authorities closed entry to a nearby village as a security measure. The identities of the wounded Palestinians and their current medical condition remain unclear. Israeli military raids on West Bank locations have intensified in recent months, drawing criticism from Palestinian officials and international observers.
